title: Debt Resolution Basics
outcome: Review ordinary debt-resolution paths and document communications with the creditor.

steps.title: Confirm the payoff amount

lines.text: Request a dated payoff statement that identifies the balance, the good-through date, and accepted payment instructions.

speed_bumps: A current balance may differ from a payoff amount because interest and fees can continue to accrue.

steps.title: Ask about hardship or settlement options

lines.text: A creditor may offer hardship, payment-plan, or settlement options under its own policies.

speed_bumps: Obtain written terms and consider possible tax, credit-reporting, or collection consequences before accepting.

steps.title: Document a dispute or validation request

lines.text: State the specific account, disputed amount, and supporting records, then retain a copy and delivery evidence.

speed_bumps: Deadlines and rights vary by debt type, jurisdiction, and the status of collection activity.

steps.title: Inventory commercial-redemption theories separately

lines.text: Commercial-redemption theories that claim a personal filing or private instrument automatically eliminates a debt are contested and are not an ordinary debt-resolution path.

speed_bumps: Do not substitute an unverified theory for a creditor-approved payment, settlement, or legally available dispute process.
flags: Claims involving fictitious financial instruments can lead to civil or criminal consequences; obtain qualified legal advice before acting.
